c.tagline: A fairy-tale fortress capital of cliffs, valleys and EU power.

taxi.fareNote: Metered fares regulated nationally; airport-to-center typically €35-40; surcharges apply at night and weekends

emergency.note: 112 also covers fire/ambulance; 113 is police; both work EU-wide as well

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_desc: Historic hilltop old town with cobbled lanes, cathedral, palace and cliffside views; best for first-time visitors who want to walk to every major sight.
Picturesque riverside district in the Alzette valley below the old town, packed with bars, restaurants and nightlife in restored 18th-century buildings; suits younger travelers and nightlife seekers.
Neighboring riverside quarter known for its brewery heritage turned nightclub and bar strip; good for visitors prioritizing evening entertainment.
Modern EU-institution business district with glass towers, museums (Mudam) and the Philharmonie; suits business travelers and those wanting contemporary architecture and chain hotels.
Residential area near the train station with budget and mid-range hotels close to rail/bus links, convenient for transit-focused stays but less scenic.
lodging: Park Inn by Radisson Luxembourg City

water.note: Rigorously tested and safe to drink straight from the tap, no filtering needed.

transit.pay: All public transport (tram, bus, train 2nd class) has been free nationwide since 29 February 2020 for both residents and tourists; no ticket or app needed for standard journeys. 1st class rail seats still require a paid ticket.
transit.hours: Buses/tram run roughly 5am-midnight; a night bus network (CityNight) covers weekends into the early morning.
transit.note: Free public transport makes Luxembourg City one of the easiest and cheapest European capitals to explore.

train: CFL national and international trains from Luxembourg Central Station, including TGV to Paris and connections to Brussels, Frankfurt and Basel

tip.r: Service is included in restaurant bills by law; rounding up or leaving 5-10% for good service is appreciated but not expected.
